title: `TIMESTAMP` (LTZ) `+ INTERVAL` follows the session time zone
verdict: the same instant plus a day is 10:00 or 11:00 UTC across a DST change, by `spark.sql.session.timeZone`
description: `TIMESTAMP '2024-03-30 11:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL 1 DAY` is 2024-03-31 12:00 in Europe/Berlin (10:00 UTC) under that session zone and 2024-03-31 11:00 under UTC. sverify pins UTC and `TIMESTAMP_NTZ` (`SPARK_CONF`), so its plans never meet this.
reference: `Kind.timeTz` is refused: the reference's calendar arithmetic on instants would need a time zone the plan does not carry.

provenance.checked_by: #1166 restatement probe (session youthful-margulis), spark 4.3.0, macOS arm64

evidence.sql: SET spark.sql.session.timeZone=Europe/Berlin; select cast(TIMESTAMP '2024-03-30 11:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL 1 DAY as string)
SET spark.sql.session.timeZone=UTC; select cast(TIMESTAMP '2024-03-30 11:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL 1 DAY as string)
